messages:
isabel: Quick Q — promoting Harry from IC -> Manager, effective 2026-08-02. Need payroll cutoff, backpay plan, bonus proration, equity timing. Short checklist?
harry: Prefer backpay in one lump sum.
meera: For the August mid run, enter the HR change by 2026-08-04 COB to hit that payroll. If missed, we can do an off-cycle (3 business days). Off-cycle fees are waived for promotions.
meera: Backpay calculation: prorate by days from effective date to last paid date; paid as a single line item "Promotion Backpay - <name>". Required docs: signed Comp Change Request PDF, manager approval email/thread, employee ID, new salary & bonus target, GL code (format HR-OP-###).
meera: Bonus proration: prorate the quarter by days under each role. Commissions/bonuses already earned remain as paid under the plan (no clawbacks).
harry: And equity timing?
meera: Manager RSU grants require comp committee approval. To request grant with 2026-08-02 grant date, submit the comp packet (current comp, proposed comp, business rationale, org snapshot) by 2026-08-03 COB. If committee approves later, grant issuance and date will reflect the approval date and may be delayed.
payroll-bot: Reminder: attach signed Comp Change Request and manager approval when emailing payroll@redwood.com. Use GL prefix "HR-OP-" plus 3 digits.
isabel: Action items: 1) Isabel to assemble signed form and comp packet and send to payroll@redwood.com by 2026-08-03 COB; 2) Meera to confirm GL code and backpay calc once packet received; 3) Payroll to process off-cycle if packet misses cutoff. Thanks all :thumbsup:
